description:
FILED s530 (Fable) at the USER's request: a register that says, for every failing CPAN test, whether perl skips it too, whether it comes from a feature PCL deliberately does not support, or whether it is a PCL bug.
Design: docs/test-verdict-register-proposal.md (the measured problem: 138 FAIL files of which 41 are PCL bugs; the cause column is free text -- 18 spellings of the NS rulings, 21 mixed cells, stale causes like the 13 JSON-PP rows citing the closed #1575).
Absorbs #4160 (the SKIP verdict).  QUEUED as s531b member 0 (briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531b-prompt.md).
Open USER question in the proposal: the companion suite (perl's own t/) in the same batch, or after one round.


=== DONE (s531b) ===
Built in the shape the s531 Fable review RULED (docs/test-verdict-register-proposal.md "## Review (s531, Fable 5.1) -- RULED"): no new register, the existing cause column hardened.
1. THE GRAMMAR: PCLCauses::parse_cause -> (class, key, note, legacy) from the leading marker (#N, NS:<id>, PARKED:<id>, PERL-SKIP, PERL-FAILS, UNREDUCED #N, HARNESS #N, UNEXPLAINED); cause_class its wrapper; a pre-grammar cell keeps s486a's class (0 differences over the five baselines).  docs/failure-cause-classes.md "The grammar".
2. STABLE IDS: 128 `<a id="ns-...">` anchors in docs/not-supported.md (four RETIRED); tools/ns-ids.pl --list|--check over tools/lib/PCLNsIds.pm; the title -> id table is in #1836.
3. THE VALIDATOR: Pl/t/verdict-register-01.t -- key only; GATE for the board, REPORT for the companion / sweep / shortfall (companion: 269 closed-key rows over 16 tasks, 2 missing #1722, 43 on id-less #407/#408; sweep 19 closed, 1 id-less; shortfall 4 closed -- #1836's queue); advisory (TODO) in a git worktree, PCL_VERDICT_STRICT=1 / PCL_TASK_STORE.  CLOSE-WITH-ROWS recorded.  The review's "#8212" is a character code in a note, not a key: 20 bad board keys, not 21.
4. THE ORACLE + SKIP + THE SPLIT: tools/run-dist-t.pl --oracle / --oracle-only (cached in ~/.pcl-cache/oracle, --refresh-oracle), run by the scoreboard as its own timed call; verdict SKIP iff both sides skip_all; TOTAL line; --causes split; MISMATCH lines; cause-census --by-id + UNREDUCED hygiene.
   THE ORACLE'S FIRST-RUN COST, measured over the whole board (30 dists, 896 files, s531b tree run 2026-11-01 01:46-03:16): 892 files measured, 208.8 s of perl in all (0.23 s a file; ~52 s of wall at --jobs 4 inside a 90-minute run), 0 timeouts; every later run reads the cache.
5. THE MIGRATION: tools/migrate-causes.pl (kept, idempotent, --check); 761 NS spellings -> ids, 28 task-first ruling cells -> NS:<id> -- #N, 54 UNREDUCED (44 by rule, 10 by hand), 6 PERL-FAILS (4 prose + 2 from the oracle's TODO rows), 4 #3530 rows LEFT, 13 x #1575 -> #3282, the rest of the 20 closed keys re-caused from one-file runs.  Filed #4181 #4182 #4183 (UNREDUCED holders), #4184 (SILENT WRONG: indirect object `new Foo, "x"`), #4185 (symbolic-glob LIST local refused), #4186 (Test::Pod: Test::Builder->exported_to missing).
THE BOARD (one tree run): BEFORE (same run, old rule) 558 PASS / 205 PARTIAL / 133 FAIL -> AFTER 558 / 205 / 66 FAIL / 67 SKIP; not-ok rows 1,249 ours / 793 ruled / 6 perl's / 0 harness; + 55,881 assertions never reached behind 104 whole-file rows (64 ours).  --diff vs the migrated baseline: 1 NEW (a load TIMEOUT, passes alone) / 10 FIXED (the kept flap + order faces) / LOST the same two.
The companion moves with #1836 (ruling 8).
subject: A VERDICT REGISTER for the CPAN board (and the other test populations): a closed cause vocabulary (PERL-SKIP / PERL-FAILS / NS:<id> / BUG / UNREDUCED / HARNESS), stable not-supported ids, a gate validator, the scoreboard split by class
